candidate_relations.reason: The benchmark reference is simply 'cone-rod dystrophy' without any subtype specification. C001 appends 'photopic predominant,' which is an additional specificity claim. While the clinical record does show predominantly photopic ERG abnormalities (attenuated photopic and 30-Hz flicker responses) in the daughter, the father's ERG also shows dark-adapted abnormalities (electronegative waveform, delayed dark-adapted 0.01 ERG), making a purely photopic-predominant label debatable. More importantly, the benchmark does not include this subtype qualifier, so C001 is more specific than the reference rather than a harmless alias, placing it as a partial/component relation rather than a complete equivalent.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Adds 'photopic predominant' subtype qualifier not present in the benchmark reference 'cone-rod dystrophy'

case_quality_flags: Father's ERG shows rod involvement (electronegative dark-adapted 3.0 ERG, delayed dark-adapted 0.01 ERG), which complicates a 'photopic predominant' subtype label applied to the family diagnosis as a whole.
